shared_elements: schematic silhouette figures arranged in rows
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic profile animals and small human-like figures set out in loose horizontal registers with a few isolated round discs, but that is about as generic as figural rock imagery gets. A shows a dense stacked hierarchy of quadrupeds, birds/reptiles with a long-necked bird and a large branching motif, all carved in raised relief with interior modelling, whereas B shows flat silhouette long boats with crew strokes and animal-headed prows plus a file of weapon-bearing figures — the boat motif and the crewed-vessel convention have no counterpart in A.
